messages.en: What are you doing, my fiancé?
I just laid down to go to sleep.
How was the meat Shion-nim grilled for you?
It was so tasty.
I'm so full.
Didn't you get a blood sugar spike??
The power of apple cider vinegar!!
I tried Dubai Chewy Cookie again today.
I'm a fan again.
It really is tasty.
ㅋㅌㅋㅌㅋㅌㅌㅋㅌㅋㅌㅋㅌㅌㅋㅌㅋㅌㅋ Why are you so easily swayed?
I've always been like that ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ.
**Y/n** is the only exception.
I'll recommend you a song.
*Cold - chan*
I love it.
The intro...
It's exactly my style.
I'm listening to it right now.
ㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅋㅋ
It's so emotional.
Is this what they call late-night feelings,.,,?
I'm going to read a book before going to sleep too.
Just trust me.
I'll study everything.
I'll make it so you never have to use your brain.
**Y/n**, just don't let my hands get wet ㅋ.
Hexdolsoe and Lady Ha.
Hippo..?
You're bringing up Jeong Hippo again?
I only use my head when cracking walnuts.
If you use it to crack walnuts, your head will split open~
Buot.
Muscle land.
Sorry.

messages.ko: 어떻게 하면 오타를 잘 넘길 수 있을까 고민하다가..
messages.en: I was thinking about how I could smoothly move past the typo...
What I actually wanted to say was...
I just miss you.

messages.ko: 이 시간이라 그런지 더 아련해지고~ 보고싶고 그러는 날이다…
messages.en: Maybe because it's this late, I feel even more sentimental~ It's one of those days where I really miss you...
But seriously...
One of the reasons I became an F is...
Without a doubt...
Because of **Y/n**.
Air fryer?
Yep, I got crispy.
You keep making me pay attention to you ㅋ.
Being so clumsy in front of me...
You're the first person who's ever been like this with me...
I told you not to eat ramen through your nose...
But you play the recorder with your nose tooㅜㅜ
Is blowing something and putting something into it the same????

messages.ko: 넌 항상 그렇게 아무것도 아닌것처럼 말하지!!!
messages.en: You always say things like they're no big deal!!!
Are we fighting?

messages.ko: 아니 ㅋ 내가 너랑 어떻게 싸우냐
messages.en: No ㅋ How could I ever fight with you?
I'm seriously going crazy ㅎ.
I'll let you winㅎㅎㅎㅎ!!!!
Should I go learn boxing?
Then I'll learn together with you.
One-two jab jab jab.
Because the weather is nice...
Because the weather isn't nice.
Because the weather is just right.
I'm always hungry.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
But I was looking through my gallery.
From when we went on tour.
There was a hotel with an amazing view.
The fact that it's become a memory somehow...
Makes me sad.
Time...ㅠ

messages.ko: 언젠가는 이 시간도 다 추억이 되겟지...
messages.en: Someday, this moment will become a memory too...
That's such a beautiful memory.
That's me back then.
I wanted to do a live that day.

messages.ko: 너무 허허벌판이여서 신호가 안잡혀서 못했었지 ㅠㅠ
messages.en: But it was such an open area that there was no signal, so I couldn't do itㅠㅠ
Why was your jawline so sharp back then?
Why are you saying I gained weight in such a roundabout way!!!!!!!
Ahㅎ
Sorry, that hit a nerve.
You're pretty even if you gain weight, noonaㅎ
Noona is so pretty~~~
I'm going crazy~~
"Here I Am Again" - Baek Yerin.
Give this a listen.
It's so good.
"Crash Landing on You" is seriously one of my favorite dramas.
I think I've watched it three times.
I think you'd adapt even better than Seri.
If I were in that kind of situation...
I'd boil potatoes by myself every day.
I'd gain a lot of weight.
And by their standards...
I'd probably become the prettiest woman there.
What if you get caught and arrested?
I'd have to use my charms.
Please let me go~

messages.ko: 그 북한말 이상하게 쓰시는분 너무 웃긴데
messages.en: That person who speaks North Korean in that funny way is so hilarious.
The one who was on SNL with Suzy-nim.
You know...
"I've lived in Gyeongsang-do for so long that I talk like this, ssibong."
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Your dialect got all mixed up.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㅋ
Listening to emotional songs...
While talking about things like this...
It snaps me out of it.
The sentimental mood.
When I was in my first year of high school...
I commuted to school.
I'd take the bus to school early in the morning.
Listening to drama OSTs on the way...
That was my happiness.
Getting completely immersed.
Wow, that's such a precious memory.
I used to wake up at 5 every day.
Put on my school uniform.
Around 6 o'clock...
I'd wake my older brother up.
And ask him to take me to the bus stop.
I'd drag him outside.
I'd eat breakfast from the convenience store while waiting for the bus.
I'd meet up with my friends along the way on the subway.
Then we'd all hike up together.
Take acting classes together.
And go to the school store...
I've already graduated.
Back then, even waking up at 5...
Made me excited.
Putting on my school uniform.
Wondering what class I'd have.
What kind of acting I'd do.
How I'd do my presentation, things like that.
At our school...
Even presentations...
Were performing a piece you'd prepared in front of everyone.
Singing.
Things like that.
That's why it was so fun.
So you'd go to the front and act?
That's right.
It's embarrassing.
But when you do well...
And get a high score...
It feels so rewarding.
And maybe because it was an arts high school...
Even when I arrived in the morning...
Everyone was overflowing with passion.
They'd get there earlier than me.
Some would be playing guitar.
Others would be singing while playing the piano.
The music department students would already be rehearsing together.
Take care, everyoneㅠㅠ
Sometimes when I see students wearing my school's uniform...
Showing up at auditions and things like that...
I don't know, it just makes me feel proud.
Even if I wasn't close with them, it's still something I can feel.

messages.ko: 아 근데 먼가 그런거 있어... 후배들 잘하는거 보면 먼가 좀 뿌듯하고 자랑스럽고 그래
messages.en: Ah, but I know what you mean... When you see your juniors doing well, you can't help but feel proud of them.

messages.ko: 교복 안버릴거지? 영원히 옷장에 두겠다고 해줘.
messages.en: You're not going to throw away your school uniform, right? Promise you'll keep it in your closet forever.
